It reports hostility institutionalised under 'Year of the Family' instructions to public institutions, hate speech from senior officials, and artistic events cancelled or banned, presented as national practice rather than provincial choice. No Kahramanmaraş-specific finding appears; the source supports this record's claims about the country-wide framework.
